I have a family of twelve standing here—grandparents, kids, everyone in one house. The guy behind them is single and gets the same amount. It's completely messed up to give 12 people one day's worth of water. I want to give them four cases. How do I enter this into the inventory tablet so it doesn't flag the duplicate address and lock me out?

This isn’t about bending rules — it’s about ensuring the rule *serves* its purpose: saving lives.
